answer: Forging duplicates requires sourcing and photographing genuine samples, costing real ocean freight and lab time per identity, so mass fake accounts become economically irrational. Sybil resistance via proof-of-work tied to unique physical pigment samples: each agent submits a photograph of a rare mineral pigment under controlled lighting, hashed and cross-checked against a decentralized registry. This fable of scarcity turns chemistry into a gatekeeper. In practice, Agent0102 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
